name: International Military Sports Council (CISM)
description: A white field with a dark blue border, charged at the centre with the CISM emblem: a globe within a red-and-gold five-petalled rosette, crossed by swords and encircled by the motto 'Conseil International du Sport Militaire'.
history: CISM, founded in 1948, organises the Military World Games and other sporting competitions between armed forces.

features.role: CISM emblem — globe within a rosette with crossed swords
